hooks.command: CHANGED=$(git status --porcelain -uall 2>/dev/null | grep -v -E '\.DS_Store$|\.tsbuildinfo$'); if [ -n "$CHANGED" ] && ! echo "$CHANGED" | grep -q "docs/PROJECT_STATUS.md"; then printf '%s' '{"decision":"block","reason":"The repo has uncommitted changes but docs/PROJECT_STATUS.md was not updated. Update the status log now (date, commit, completed work, tests actually run and results, blockers, next three tasks), then finish again. Never mark untested work as complete."}'; else printf '{}'; fi
